THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour whichaccompanies this order exists between,
Mr. B. M. Pradeep Manjula, No. 105/5, Thalgaswatta, Kumbukmulla, Hakuruwela. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo - 05. of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vestedin me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. Suneth Lokubogahawatta, No. 89/F, Kumudu Mawatha, Nampamunuwa, Piliyandala to bethe arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.08th August, 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. B. M. Pradeep Manjula, No. 105/5, Thalgaswatta, Kumbukmulla, Hakuruwela. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo - 05. of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the disciplinery inquiry conducted on 29.09.2014 and the punishments given in respect of that to Mr. B. M. PradeepManjula, working as a Conductor of the Sri Lanka Transport Board are just and if not, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 06th day of August, 2018.

and
National Savings Bank, No. 255, Galle Road, Colombo - 03. of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the below - named 07 employees inclusive of Mrs. Rathnawali Mallika de Joeth who worked at the National SavingsBank have been caused injustice by not being placed in the correct salary steps relevant to the backdated promotionsrepectively when they had been promoted to Grade III Class III from 04.03.1987, Grade III Class II from 01.01.1988 and Grade IIIClass I from 01.01.1991 and if so, to what relief they are entitled.

1. Mrs. Rathnawali Mallika de Joeth2. Mrs. H. D. N. D. Siriwardena3. Mrs. G. T. M. Indrani Thanthrige4. Mrs. B. M. K. Karunaratne5. Mrs. G. K. K. Weerasinghe6. Mr. I. L. Herath7. Mr. Stanley Weerasinghe
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
